questions.text: A club has 64 boys and 38 girls. After 19 boys and 8 girls joined, the ratio of boys to girls changed. What is the new ratio of boys to girls in simplest form?
A bicycle was marked at $125. It was sold at a 15% discount, then a 7% service charge was added to the discounted price. How much did the customer pay altogether?
A library had 372 books. 3/6 of them were fiction books. After 25 fiction books were borrowed, how many fiction books were left?
A rectangular tank measures 50 cm by 31 cm by 27 cm. It is 35% filled with water. How many cubic centimetres of water are in the tank?
A bus travelled at 50 km/h for 3 hours. After a 20-minute stop, it travelled another 1 hour at 62 km/h. What was the total distance travelled?
Mina had 26 stickers. Leo had 4 times as many stickers as Mina. Leo gave 16 stickers to Mina. How many stickers did they have altogether after the exchange?
A rectangle has length 19 cm and width 13 cm. Its length is increased by 4 cm and its width is decreased by 2 cm. What is the change in its area?
The average score of 6 students was 71. When one more student joined the group, the new average became 73. What score did the new student get?
A shopkeeper mixed 18 kg of rice costing $4 per kg with 12 kg of rice costing $6 per kg. What was the average cost per kg of the mixture?
A train left Town A at 9:15 a.m. and reached Town B at 12:45 p.m. If it travelled 252 km, what was its average speed in km/h?
